rationale: The Latin anchors *sculpere* (to sculpt/engrave) and *delineare* (to trace/delineate) point to incising or cutting into a surface rather than shaping a free-standing object; the attestation referencing an image of the Lord carved/depicted on a tablet (*tabula depictam*) confirms the sense of engraving or cutting into a surface. This matches carve.v.02 ("engrave or cut by chipping away at a surface") more precisely than carve.v.01 (forming a 3D object) or carve.v.03 (cutting into pieces).
